svg.title: Wavetable synth — Matrix tab (proposal)
svg.desc: The synth window's Matrix tab: one row per modulation route with source, bipolar amount slider, bipolar toggle, aux source and amount, target and remove; an empty row adds a route; the modulation strip stays at the bottom.
svg.text: add a route: choose a source and a target
scales the route: e.g. the mod
the same as dragging a source
onto a knob on the Osc tab
Proposal mockup — sizes and spacing indicative. The arcs on the Osc tab and these rows are two views of the same routes.
